notes: HeatWatch now tracks your idle temperatures and shows the baseline next to your gaming peaks
patch_notes: HeatWatch now records idle temperatures — one sample a minute while no game is running — and shows the 24-hour median as an idle baseline in the repaste verdict card, next to your gaming peaks. A rising idle baseline is an early sign of dust or drying paste. The first five minutes after a session ends are skipped so post-game heat never pollutes the baseline, and a tick with no temperature source is dropped, never guessed. New test round 19 covers the recording throttle, the 24-hour median window, the post-game cooldown and the verdict-card label; all 19 rounds pass.
